title: tools/1: the catalog of the assistant tools
description: The catalog `mzlab-cli llm tools [--demo]` prints and `docs/schemi/tools-1.json` / `tools-demo-1.json` hold (those two are data snapshots; this is their JSON Schema, in a file of its own because the name tools-1.json is taken). The CLI adds `citation` and `cli_catalog` (the command that lists every command). Code: crates/mzlab-llm/src/tools.rs.
